reviews.comment: This class isn't that bad! There are 2 group presentations which everyone in the class ends up getting the same grade on (an A) and there are 2 exams which are easy if you look over her slides. Only downside is attendance + class participation is a LARGE part of your final grade - BUT it can boost you so much if you show up and talk. Take her!!
This class focused way too much on group projects with nick picky feedback. Do not take her.

Her 1st years of teaching but the grading rubric is strict and vague. She heavily grades class participation which you won't know your grade until the last week of semester. Additionally, there are only 2 exams which each cover 1/2 of the semester which is not effective for learning. Group presentations are graded seriously with vague feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things
